exact_code_recipes.code:
Cold Brew Coffee & Cafe

Bold coffee.
Better moments.

The fan favorites, best served cold. Single-origin Arabica, slow-steeped for 18 hours.
exact_code_recipes.how_to_wire: This is the full hero section. Requires .sky-bg, .cloud, .cloud-layer-rear, .cloud-layer-front CSS from the Cloud Parallax recipe. Floating cups use .animate-float, .animate-float-diagonal, .animate-float-slow classes with staggered animation-delay. Splash droplets are small colored circles with the same float animations.

anti_hallucination_guidance: BANNED: Do not invent float keyframes from scratch — use proven @keyframes float/float-slow/float-diagonal from mission-control and story-spark-ai repos.
BANNED: Do not build cloud parallax from scratch — use proven REAR/FRONT cloud drift pattern from streetmix.
BANNED: Do not use lorem ipsum for any text — all copy must be real end-user copy matching the machi reference.
BANNED: Do not add more than ONE motion moment (the floating cups hero is the ONE orchestrated moment). Everything else stays static.
BANNED: Do not use generic rainbow gradients — the palette must match the specific sky blue + pastel system from the reference.
